remarks: This bright and roomy top-floor 2-bedroom, 1-bath garden-style apartment is ideally situated near downtown and I-95. The unit has been freshly painted and boasts hardwood floors throughout, along with a modernized kitchen. Rent includes heat, hot water, a storage unit, trash removal, and one reserved parking space. The landlord requires a 2-month security deposit, verifiable references, proof of income, and excellent credit. It's within walking distance to Chelsea Piers, shops, and restaurants. Schedule your private viewing before it's taken!
